summary: HPS Corporate Lending Fund entered into an Eleventh Supplemental Indenture to issue $600 million of 6.300% senior unsecured notes due 2031 in a Rule 144A offering. Interest is payable semi-annually; notes may be redeemed at the Fund's option. The filing is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation, as it involves ordinary capital markets activity without triggering an acquisition, divestiture, or other event-driven category.
